palette: slate navy factoring hall, gold funding rails, teal recourse ribbons, brick void stamps, bone paper, gunmetal ink
typography: factoring headings on slate rail tabs, bone chips with gold and teal seals
composition: a factoring hall where the receivable fork splits recourse and non-recourse desks, the confirmation board rules on fictional credits by notice moment, and the priority racetrack ranks registration notice and proportion with the five-claimant case ledger
surface: bone paper dossiers, slate desk rails, gold funding stamps
motion: receivable coins run to the factor while the recourse ribbon either returns them to the creditor or not, confirmation and notice-moment stamps flip the debtor payment verdict, and priority tokens sprint the racetrack from registration through notice to proportion
transition: the slate hall floor, gold rails and brick stamp posts persist while desks, boards and racetracks are re-dressed between scenes
